learning_objective: 🎯 Hop along the number line with animals to master awesome multiplication and division tricks!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🦘 Skip Counting on the Number Line
main_concepts.simple_explanation: If a frog jumps 3 steps at a time, we skip count: 3, 6, 9, 12! This is a fun visual way to see the multiplication table in action.
If a kangaroo makes 5 giant jumps, and each jump is 4 meters long, we multiply 5 times 4 to find out it traveled 20 meters in total!
If a rabbit needs to travel 15 meters and jumps 3 meters each time, we divide 15 by 3 to see it needs exactly 5 jumps to finish!

fun_activity.title: 🦘 My Frog Jump Math
fun_activity.instructions: Mark a starting line on the floor. Take 4 giant jumps forward. Ask someone to measure one jump, then multiply it by 4 to find your total distance!

quick_recap: ⭐ Skip counting on a number line is just like doing multiplication.
⭐ We multiply to find the total distance of many equal jumps.
⭐ We divide to figure out how many jumps are needed to reach a spot!
